items.prompt: Which word means the same as big?

options.why: Tiny means very small. That is the opposite.
Slow is about speed, not size.
Short means not tall or not long.

hints: A word that means the same is called a synonym.
Think of another word for something huge.
Read the sentence: The elephant is very ___. Which word fits as well as big?
items.explanation: Large means the same as big, so it is a synonym of big.

items.prompt: Which word is the opposite of empty?

options.why: Open is the opposite of closed.
Hollow means empty inside. That is not the opposite.
Clean is the opposite of dirty.

hints: A word that means the opposite is called an antonym.
Think of a glass with no water in it. What is it like after you fill it?
Say: The box was empty. Then it was ___.
items.explanation: Full is the opposite of empty. An empty box has nothing in it, and a full box has no room left.

items.prompt: Match each word to a synonym.
hints: A synonym means the same or nearly the same.
Try each pair in a sentence. Does the meaning stay the same?
Start with begin. Which word could you swap it for?
items.explanation: Synonyms mean the same or nearly the same, like begin and start.

items.prompt: Match each word to its antonym.
hints: An antonym means the opposite.
Think of a word that changes the meaning completely.
Start with push. What is the opposite thing you can do to a door?
items.explanation: Antonyms are opposites, like push and pull, or ancient (very old) and modern (new).

items.prompt: Which word means said very loudly?

options.why: Mumbled means said in a way that is hard to hear.

hints: Many words can be used instead of said.
Think about how loud each word is.
Which word would you use for calling a friend across a big field?
items.explanation: Shouted means said very loudly. It is a stronger synonym for said.

items.prompt: Sort the words by meaning.
hints: Read each word and think about how it feels.
Would you smile or frown if you felt this way?
Start with joyful. Is it a smiling word?
items.explanation: Cheerful, joyful, glad and delighted are synonyms of happy. Sad, miserable, gloomy and upset are antonyms.

items.prompt:
Write the antonym of shallow.
The pool is ___ at this end, so only strong swimmers can go here.
hints: An antonym is the opposite.
Shallow water does not go down very far.
What do we call water that goes down a long way?
items.explanation: Deep is the opposite of shallow. Deep water goes down a long way.

items.prompt: Which word could replace walked to show that Bayu was very tired?

options.why: Dashed means ran fast. A tired person moves slowly.
Skipping is a happy, bouncy way to move.

hints: Think about how a tired person moves.
All the words are ways of moving. Some are fast and some are slow.
Which word sounds slow and heavy?
items.explanation: Trudged means walked slowly with heavy steps, like someone who is very tired.

items.prompt: Which pair of words are antonyms?

options.why: Hot and warm are close in meaning.
These words often go together. They are not opposites.

hints: Antonyms are opposites.
Look for a pair that mean completely different things.
Picture each pair. Which pair are at two ends, like day and night?
items.explanation: Hot and cold are opposites, so they are antonyms.

items.prompt: Choose all the words that mean the same as look.

options.why: Listen is what you do with your ears.

hints: Look is something you do with your eyes.
Some of these words are quick looks and some are long looks.
For each word, ask: do you use your eyes to do it?
items.explanation: Glance, stare and peek are all ways of looking. Listen and shout are not.

items.prompt:
Write the antonym of arrive.
The train will ___ at six o'clock and reach the city at nine.
hints: An antonym is the opposite.
Arrive means come to a place.
What does the train do at the very start of its trip?
items.explanation: Leave is the opposite of arrive. The train leaves at six and arrives at nine. Depart works too.

items.prompt: In which sentence does light mean the opposite of heavy?

options.text: It gets light at six o'clock.
options.why: Here light is the opposite of dark.
Here light means brightness from a lamp or the sun.

hints: Light has more than one meaning.
Find the sentence that is about how much something weighs.
Try saying heavy instead of light. In which sentence does heavy make sense?
items.explanation: In My bag is light today, light means not heavy. In the other sentences, light is about lamps, the sun or not being dark.

items.prompt: Which word means the same as enormous?
hints: Enormous means very big.
Find another word for very big.
It starts with h.
items.explanation: Huge means the same as enormous.

items.prompt: Which word is the opposite of ancient?
hints: Ancient means very old.
The opposite means new.
It starts with m.
items.explanation: Modern is the opposite of ancient.

items.prompt: Which word is the opposite of brave?
hints: Brave means not afraid.
The opposite means very afraid.
It starts with c.
items.explanation: Cowardly is the opposite of brave.

items.prompt: Which word means to look at something closely?
hints: Think of a scientist with a lens.
The word means study with care.
It starts with e.
items.explanation: Examine means to look closely.

options.why: Ignore means to pay no attention.
Hide means to put out of sight.

items.prompt: Match the words that mean the same.
hints: Same-meaning words are called synonyms.
Do the easy ones first.
Rapid means fast.
items.explanation: Each pair means nearly the same.

items.prompt: Match the opposites.
hints: Opposites are antonyms.
Think of a pillow and a stone.
Start with hard.
items.explanation: Each pair means the opposite.

items.prompt: Sort the words by meaning.
hints: Think of a warm day and a cold day.
Which words fit each?
Scorching is very hot.
items.explanation: Warm, boiling and scorching are hot. Chilly, freezing and icy are cold.

items.prompt: Write a word that means the same as begin. It starts with s.
hints: Think of the beginning of a race.
It has five letters.
Ready, set, go.
items.explanation: Start means the same as begin.

items.prompt: Write the opposite of increase. It starts with d.
hints: Increase means get bigger.
The opposite means get smaller.
It has eight letters.
items.explanation: Decrease is the opposite of increase.

items.prompt: Which word does not mean the same as angry?
hints: Three words are about being upset.
One word is about being pleased.
Find the happy word.
items.explanation: Delighted means very pleased, not angry.

items.prompt: The room was silent. Which word means the same as silent?
hints: Silent is about sound.
Find the word about no noise.
It starts with q.
items.explanation: Quiet means the same as silent.

items.prompt: Which word is the opposite of scarce?
hints: Scarce means hard to find.
The opposite means easy to find.
There is a lot.
items.explanation: Plentiful is the opposite of scarce.

options.why: Rare means there is very little.

items.prompt: Choose all the words that mean very big.
hints: Very big words are strong.
Two words are for very big things.
Think of an elephant.
items.explanation: Enormous and gigantic both mean very big.
